_comment: A battle with the bow (items.json "bow": its battle clips, docs/engine/05_ANIMATION.md "Characters"): the player's character draws and holds the bow (charge) while the attack waits, shoots when the combo ends (attack), and lowers it (idle) while the attack recovers. A sturdy slime that hardly attacks, so the bow can be watched. Battle v3 (docs/gameplay/07 phase 1): the tap at frame 40 starts the combo (charge 640 of 2200 ms), and the three taps after it land on the bow's Lv 1 points (1/4, 2/4, 3/4 of the track, about 21, 41 and 62 frames later at --fixed-dt=16): all three hit, the bow shoots.
